discord_348205: JavaScript patches match the desktop reference build exactly: all 142 functions it changes are changed identically, verified byte for byte against that build's shipped bundle. Those patches are pinned to Discord 348.5's bundle; a different release's bundle is refused rather than patched with stale function ids, because Hermes numbers functions per bundle and an id from one release names an unrelated function in another.
The 81-entry network blocklist is not ported. It is a generated interceptor method rather than a set of edits, and its absence is the main remaining gap against the desktop build.

Most AndroidManifest edits are not ported. The split declarations and extractNativeLibs are handled, but removing whole elements (five dead permissions, the Sentry providers, Play split metadata, the AppsFlyer intent query) and rewriting the RPC service's exported flag are not implemented yet.

Adding or rebuilding resource-table entries is not possible in a surgical repack, so the ExoPlayer drawable aliases the desktop build creates are absent. The upstream APK ships without them and runs, so this matches Discord's own behaviour rather than introducing a gap.

The reference's four media edits stay disabled for the reasons it documents: they crash the camera on open, shrink capture below the encoder's expectation, strip a live string, or pass an undocumented value to the native media engine.
Signed with sleepy's own key, so it installs as a different app identity: uninstall the official Discord first, and it will not receive official updates.
octogram_361: Two patch entries target OctoGram 3.6.0, for which no source is registered, so they never run on this build.

The OTA update check is disabled and the logger is silenced, but stub bodies here use .locals 0 where the reference reuses each method's original register count. The assembled code is equivalent; the text differs.
Premium paywall removal is partial. The reference documents 53 of 61 presentation paths blocked, with profile premium rows, PremiumFeatureCell and LimitPreviewView still rendering.
Signed with sleepy's own key, so it installs as a different app identity and will not receive official updates.

sources.description: Discord Alpha from Vendetta tracker. Automatically merges ARM64 native shared libraries into a universal APK, neutralizes Sentry native/Java crash reporters, disables AppsFlyer telemetry, nulls the in-bundle JS Sentry DSN, and locks the patched JS bundle.

Official OctoGram arm64 release asset from GitHub, patched on-device. Removes channel sponsored messages, interstitial photo ads and search sponsored channels, stops GitHub update checks, and silences OctoGram's logging and Firebase telemetry. Premium paywall entry points are reduced rather than eliminated.
